analysis.reason: All tests return undefined values or output to unknown ports, indicating no real data was retrieved.
analysis.description: Test 1 and Test 2 both exit with code 0 and output to the 'out' port, but all field values are 'undefined' (Post ID, Title, Status, Web URL, Created). This means no actual post data was returned — the output structure exists but contains no real data, which violates the requirement that output must contain real data (not empty objects or undefined values). Test 3 outputs to an 'unknown' port and appears to only be performing validation/configuration checks rather than testing actual component functionality. None of the three tests successfully return meaningful post data from the ListPosts component.
